steps.evidence: Walls placed. Now placing brackets. Need to calculate: seat=6.49 (column top), tiers×reach = 3.18 (ring1 out_from_outer_columns), tiers×rise must make bracket top = ring1 underside - arm depth = 9.33 - 0.315 = 9.015.
